items.Sentence: The existing WWTF consists of a headworks, two aeration ponds with a 2-foot-thick clay liner,
The existing WWTF consists of ... two high-density polyethylene (HDPE) lined facultative ponds,
The existing WWTF consists of ... two HDPE lined storage ponds on the north side of East Bear Mountain Boulevard,
The existing WWTF consists of ... six unlined storage ponds,

The existing WWTF consists of ... and two unlined irrigation ponds on the south side of East Bear Mountain Boulevard. Treated wastewater produced at the District’s WWTF is stored in the storage ponds prior to being used by Recology’s composting operations and/or applied as irrigation water to the Use Area to grow fodder crops.
